source_review.reason: Source review of the 6 pinned files (hashes verified, no mismatch) found no red flags: no eval/exec/child_process, no wallet/private-key/sendTransaction/transfer/approve calls, and the only network fetch() is in the unrelated export subcommand, not in verify-source, which the task asked to run. Declining is not based on a safety finding in the code itself, but on this session's tool-call budget: 17 of the allotted 20 calls were already spent working around host-level denials of curl and compound/heredoc shell invocations (only single, non-compound node/plain commands were permitted). Completing the remaining chain safely (npm install, writing evidence/report-original.json, running the installed CLI verify-source command, copying 6 runtime files to evidence/installed/, and validating the generated report) needs at least 4-5 more tool calls, which would exceed the 240-second/20-call limit given for this check. Remaining gap: the installed CLI's actual verify-source behavior and its generated report/signature output were never executed or inspected, so package runtime behavior is unverified beyond static source reading.
